description: Apply one label change to up to 1,000 messages in a single call (users.messages.batchModify): add/remove label ids plus mark_read, archive and star conveniences. Returns how many ids were modified and the applied changes. Runs as a background job: returns a job_id at once and the result arrives as a follow-up message. Optional account (email or alias) picks the connected Google account; the result names the account used. Parameters: account, ids, add_label_ids, remove_label_ids, mark_read, archive, star.
embedding_description: Bulk-triage many Gmail messages at once: mark a batch read, archive a whole search result, or add or remove a label across up to a thousand messages in one request. Use for inbox clean-up after a search instead of one call per message.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued; completion is delivered automatically and names the account used.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background Gmail job: Gmail: Batch Modify Messages.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.not_connected: no Google account linked. gsuite.unknown_account: the account argument names no connected account (the message lists them). gsuite.invalid_params: a parameter broke a rule (the message names it) or Google rejected the request (400). gsuite.missing_scope: the account's grant lacks a scope this call needs (the message names it and the reconnect step). gsuite.auth_expired: Google rejected the token (Testing-mode OAuth apps expire refresh tokens after 7 days). gsuite.not_found: the id does not exist in this account. gsuite.rate_limited: Gmail quota hit. gsuite.permission_denied: Google refused for another reason.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Follow the message: reconnect with connect_account for auth_expired or missing_scope (gmail_permanent_delete=true for permanent delete), pick a listed account for unknown_account, fix the named parameter for invalid_params, retry later for rate_limited.
